panel_description_zh: 中景平视，妻子刚推门进家（瑜伽归来装）；脸微红（瑜伽后血色）；高马尾但已经松散（有几缕掉下来）；手里提着一个塑料零食袋；脸 3/4 侧面，能看到蹙眉；身后门外的走廊光。

dialogue_or_narration.speaker: 妻子
dialogue_or_narration.text_zh: 李斌，不用想我都知道你这一天又干嘛，打游戏，还能有什么事呦，人家老公有点空闲时间，都知道去跑跑滴滴，送外卖，再不济也知道网上找找兼职。都想法子钻研赚钱，你到好……整天就是知道打游戏打游戏，钻他妈那游戏里面，那家里不用我说，肯定又是……

prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions. Eye-level medium shot from inside the apartment looking toward the entryway as a 30-something East Asian Chinese woman has just pushed the front door open and is stepping in. Yoga-class-returned outfit: black sports bra layered under a sage green zip-up jacket, charcoal grey high-waisted leggings, white sneakers (not yet changed into house slippers). Face shown in three-quarter side view, the cheeks slightly flushed from the yoga workout, the high ponytail already loosened with a few strands escaped around the face. Expression: eyebrows drawn down and inward at the bridge in a scowl, eyes narrowed, mouth closed, jaw clenched, a slightly tired edge to the anger. Long straight black hair mostly tied in a high ponytail with loose strands, single pearl stud earring visible, small gold locket at neckline. One hand holds a translucent plastic snack bag with a few items inside, the other hand still on the door handle. Behind her the dim hallway ceiling light. Warm white entryway light, slightly yellow-shifted to indicate evening at about 8:15pm. Mood: the return, the resuming of command, the second long speech of the day begins. Text watermark 'P12-PN01' in the bottom-right corner.
negative_prompt_en: anime proportions, full frontal face shot, smiling, husband visible in the room, decorative hallway art, daylight from a window, second character, bloodshot eyes, anime anger vein marks, romantic soft lighting
